newsitem.title: FRANCE: Barry Callebaut France cuts Seita stake.
newsitem.headline: Barry Callebaut France cuts Seita stake.

text.p: French cigarette company Seita said on Thursday that Barry Callebaut France had cut its stake in Seita to 0.5 percent from 1.5 percent previously.
In a statement Seita said Barry Callebaut France had sold the one percent stake or 518,000 shares, to Societe Suisse d'Assurances, a member of Seita's group of core shareholders.
Societe Suisse d'Assurances now owns 1.812 million Seita shares or 3.5 percent of its capital.
The eleven members of Seita's group of core shareholders together control 25.75 percent of the group's capital.
Barry Callebaut France is the French unit of cocoa processor Barry Callebaut.
